SUBJECT: ILLUMINATED SIGNS


EFFECTIVE:            Immediately

PURPOSE:              To provide consistent guidelines for inspectors and plan examiners
                      regarding illuminated signs in certain commercial districts.

SPECIFICS:

        In the past, there had been some inconsistency in the interpretation of Zoning Resolution
§32-64 Surface Area and Illumination Provisions, which regulates illuminated signs in
commercial districts. This section deals with maximum surface area and whether illuminated
and flashing signs are permitted. The differing interpretation arises in §32-641 Total Surface
Area of Signs, which applies in all C districts, and states in part"... all permitted signs, including
non-illuminated or illuminated..." This has sometimes been interpreted to mean that illuminated
signs are permitted in all C districts. This is not the case. Illuminated signs are not permitted
in C3, C5-1, C5-2, C5-3 and C5-5 zoning districts.
                                             -2



      The illuminated sign provisions of the Zoning Resolution should be interpreted as follows:

      §32-643       Permits: illuminated non-flashing signs in C1 and C2 zoning districts
                    provided they meet the specified surface area and maximum area
                    requirements.

      §32-644      Permits: illuminated or flashing signs in C4, C5-4, C6 and C7 zoning
                   districts provided they meet the specified surface area and maximum area
                   requirements (except in C6-5, C6-7 and C7 where there are no size
                   restrictions).
                   Prohibits: flashing signs in C6-1A zoning districts.

     §32-645       Permits: illuminated or flashing signs or advertising signs with indirect
                   illumination in C8 zoning districts provided they meet the specified surface
                   area and maximum area requirements.
